macros.name: Centerline
macros.doc: Places 〈content〉 into a box of width \linewidth and centers it inside this box (even if the content is wider).

macros.name: Colorbox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 into a box with the given background 〈color〉.

macros.name: Colorbox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 into a box with the given background 〈color〉.

macros.name: Dashbox
macros.doc: Like \Framebox but uses a dashed line instead.

macros.name: Dashbox
macros.doc: Like \Framebox but uses a dashed line instead.

macros.name: Dbox
macros.doc: Like \Fbox but uses a dashed line instead.

macros.name: Dlbox
macros.doc: Like \Lbox but draws the layers with dashed lines instead.

macros.name: Dlbox
macros.doc: Like \Lbox but draws the layers with dashed lines instead.

macros.name: Fbox
macros.doc: Draws a frame around 〈content〉 with a line width of \fboxrule and a separation of \fboxsep.

macros.name: Fcolorbox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 into a box with the given 〈background color〉 and draws a frame around it like \Fbox but with a given 〈frame color〉.

macros.name: Fcolorbox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 into a box with the given 〈background color〉 and draws a frame around it like \Fbox but with a given 〈frame color〉.

macros.name: Frame
macros.doc: Similar to \Fbox but does draw the frame tightly around its content with no separation.

macros.name: Framebox
macros.doc: Like \Makebox but draws a frame like \Fbox.

macros.name: Framebox
macros.doc: Like \Makebox but draws a frame like \Fbox.

macros.name: Lbox
macros.doc: Draws some solid background layers to the lower right of the content which produces a shadow effect.

macros.name: Lbox
macros.doc: Draws some solid background layers to the lower right of the content which produces a shadow effect.

macros.name: Leftline
macros.doc: Places 〈content〉 into a box of width \linewidth and left aligns it inside this box.

macros.name: Llap
macros.doc: Places 〈content〉 into a box of zero width so that it laps over to the left site.

macros.name: Makebox
macros.doc: Places the 〈content〉 in a box of width 〈width〉 (by default the native width) and horizontally aligns it accordantly to 〈position〉.

macros.name: Makebox
macros.doc: Places the 〈content〉 in a box of width 〈width〉 (by default the native width) and horizontally aligns it accordantly to 〈position〉.

macros.name: Parbox
macros.doc: Places the 〈content〉 into a paragraph box of the given 〈width〉.

macros.name: Parbox
macros.doc: Places the 〈content〉 into a paragraph box of the given 〈width〉.

macros.name: Raisebox
macros.doc: Raises the 〈content〉 by 〈length〉.

macros.name: Raisebox
macros.doc: Raises the 〈content〉 by 〈length〉.

macros.name: Reflectbox
macros.doc: This reflects the 〈content〉 and is equal to \Scalebox{-1}{1}{〈content〉}.

macros.name: Resizebox
macros.doc: Resizes the 〈content〉 to the given 〈width〉 and/or 〈height〉.

macros.name: Resizebox*
macros.doc: Resizes the 〈content〉 to the given 〈width〉 and/or 〈height〉.

macros.name: Rightline
macros.doc: Places 〈content〉 into a box of width \linewidth and right aligns it inside this box.

macros.name: Rlap
macros.doc: Places 〈content〉 into a box of zero width so that it laps over to the right site.

macros.name: Rotatebox
macros.doc: Rotates the 〈content〉 by 〈angle〉 which is be default in degrees anti-clockwise (360 = full circle).

macros.name: Rotatebox
macros.doc: Rotates the 〈content〉 by 〈angle〉 which is be default in degrees anti-clockwise (360 = full circle).

macros.name: Savebox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 in a box of the given width and alignment like \Makebox and stores it in 〈\boxregister〉.

macros.name: Savebox
macros.doc: Sets the 〈content〉 in a box of the given width and alignment like \Makebox and stores it in 〈\boxregister〉.

macros.name: Sbox
macros.doc: This saves the 〈content〉 into the given 〈\boxregister〉, which must be first allocated using \newsavebox{〈\boxregister〉}.

macros.name: Scalebox
macros.doc: Scales the 〈content〉 by the given 〈scale〉 factor.

macros.name: Scalebox
macros.doc: Scales the 〈content〉 by the given 〈scale〉 factor.
